entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, [And] from a deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of  juniper.

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I am [for] peace: But when I speak, they are for war.
